measurementCaveat.finding: _inbox is a LIVE directory being written to by concurrent lanes during this audit.
measurementCaveat.evidence: planner CP1 measured 2,620; SA-1 measured 2,621; planner re-measured 2,623 at CP2. Log counts moved 892 -> 929 across the same window.
measurementCaveat.implication: Any _inbox count is a timestamped snapshot, not a stable fact. Every _inbox figure in repo_map.md and the backlog MUST carry its measurement timestamp, or it will read as wrong within hours.
measurementCaveat.notADiscrepancy: The three counts do not disagree; they are three correct measurements of a moving population. Recorded explicitly so a future reader does not treat the drift as a counting error.

planner: _sales/ is cited by FIVE tracked docs including the ratified 00_README.md and Pricing/00_pricing_basis.md, yet is 0-of-6 tracked
convergentFinding.whyItCompounds: The standing stale-clone rewind hazard means a shared clone can be rewound. Material never committed cannot be recovered by ANY git operation. Untracked canonical material is therefore not a tidiness issue; it is an unrecoverable-loss exposure.
